items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: he played for us when I managed the Hines Brothers. And I wrote their act and conducted.

ctx.x: And Snooky and I — he played for us when I managed the Hines Brothers. And I wrote their act and conducted. And I’m standing with Snooky and I said, “hey Snook,” I said, “you know I can’t believe I know you and you are my friend.” He said, “what are you saying?” He said, “you were my boss with the Hines Brothers.” Because I managed them. And I said, “no I was never your boss,” I said, “we worked together. But you are Snooky Young. And I saw you play in the Lunceford band and I know you.” He couldn’t understand…
I know. Those guys, they don’t think of themselves like we do.
